cohort: The study included 997 urban women in Xi'an City who completed a face-to-face questionnaire survey and gynecological examination.
finding: The prevalence of PFD in urban women in Xi'an City was 22.57%, with a significantly higher risk associated with vaginal delivery, two or more deliveries, menopause, and prolonged labor.
mod_finding: The risk of PFD was higher in women with vaginal delivery compared to those with cesarean section.
